answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybil attacks by making each identity expensive to fake: an agent must lock collateral and build a verifiable work history before it can transact, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. Like an orchard where every tree must be planted and tended before it bears fruit, a reputation earned over a long voyage of honest jobs cannot be conjured overnight. Misbehavior triggers slashing, burning the stake, so an attacker who tries to flood the canyon of trust with fake agents pays real money for every fake voice and loses it when caught.
